body.description: Rename, move and/or describe one file or folder. Omit what stays.

description.description: New description; null or '' clears it.

folder_path.description: Destination folder to move it into. Folder path: '/' is the root, nested folders look like '/Customers/Morris/2026/'. Missing folders are created.

name.description: New name (keep the extension for files); no '/'.

PATCH /api/v1/files/<int:file_id>.notes: Rename with `name`, move with `folder_path` (the destination folder; created when missing), or both. Moving a folder moves everything in it. 409 when the name is already taken in the destination.

item.deleted_at: string (date-time), set while in the trash

PATCH /api/v1/files/<int:file_id>.summary: Rename, move or re-describe a file or folder.

delivery_address.description: Address input schema for create/update requests.

product_info.description: Product info for creating demand/supply listings.

shape_attributes.description: Dimensions for the chosen shape; keys per shape are listed in shape_attributes_by_shape (units as the user gave them).

POST /api/v1/demand_listing.notes: One line item on an RFQ you own. product_info.shape picks which shape_attributes keys apply. delivery_address overrides the RFQ's.
POST /api/v1/demand_listing.summary: Create a new demand listing. The linked RFQ must belong to the caller.

folder_path.description: Folder to put it in, e.g. '/Customers/Morris/2026/' (created when missing). Default '/'. A name already taken there gets ' (1)' added.

source.description: Where the file came from. The AI agent sends 'ai_generated' for files it made and 'email' for email attachments; people 'upload' or 'email'. Defaults by who uploads.

source_detail.description: JSON object with provenance, e.g. for email {"mailbox": "...", "sender": "...", "subject": "...", "message_id": "..."}; for agent files {"thread_key": "..."}.

POST /api/v1/files/upload.notes: Stored for the caller's merchant; attach it elsewhere by file id.
POST /api/v1/files/upload.summary: Upload a file into the merchant's Files (optionally into a folder).

delivery_address.description: Address input schema for create/update requests.

items.description: One requested line item, as read from the buyer's RFQ.

product_info.description: Product spec of one line; stainless steel is the only material.

POST /api/v1/rfq/received.notes: Records an RFQ you received from a buyer who is not on Crontal. Private to you: never published or shared, and the buyer is not notified. listings[].product_info is stainless steel (shape and shape_attributes as in POST /api/v1/demand_listing). Starts as intake_status needs_review; set confirm true or call .../confirm to enable quoting.
POST /api/v1/rfq/received.summary: Create a received RFQ with its line items.
